name: Bikaji Foods International Ltd
title: Bikaji Foods International Ltd - 543653 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Bikaji reports ~18% Q4 top-line growth and FY26 revenue of ~INR 2,994 crore at 9.5% volume growth, but management flagged a 3% price rise, packaging cost spikes and a supply disruption, with no capacity added in FY26.

utilisation.quote: we have not added much capacity last year. But yes, this year, we have plan to increase the capacity in sweets

capex.quote: this year, we'll be doing close to INR100 crores of capex. That's the plan, less than or close to INR100 crores capex.

triggers.label: Price rise ~3% taken April
triggers.quote: the price hike was close to 3%

triggers.label: Sweets capacity build, ~INR100 cr capex
triggers.quote: we are building one sweet factory in Bikaner, which will solve this sweets production issue

triggers.label: Warehouse FG cover <2 days to 6-8 days
triggers.quote: currently, we have space of keeping finished good less than 2 days. And this warehouse has capacity to keep storage of around 6 to 8 days

triggers.label: Packaging cost ~25-30% up, edible oil 12-14%
triggers.quote: packaging material has increased to close to 25%, 30%

guidance.quote: our target is to be -- to maintain the same gross margin and that's -- and EBITDA lens largely
What we look at it is that's about 13 plus/minus kind of growth we'll look at from core states
from focus states would be, of course, up 20%

guidance.value: 8 to 10 stores a year, 50-55% top line growth
guidance.quote: Intent is to open 8, 10 stores every year for next 3 years and to grow our business at 50%, 55% top line growth
ad budget this year will be close to 2%, which is same from last year

red_flags.label: Q4 EBITDA margin down; ad spend 3.2-3.3% in H2 vs 1% H1
red_flags.quote: 3Q and 4Q ad cost was close to average 3.2%, 3.3%.

red_flags.label: Western snacks growth slowed to ~8.5%
red_flags.quote: if you look at 8.5% growth, while certainly we could have done better

red_flags.label: Grammage cut in Impulse packs
red_flags.quote: we have reduced gram mage Impulse

evasions.quote: it's manageable. but yes, overall, what we have done

evasions.topic: Unorganised player exits / GST impact quantification
evasions.quote: I cannot – I have very bullish number on this stuff
